answer: Agents trading grove timber, river transport, and lotus seeds must lock $100 in escrow for each identity allowed to submit one bid per minute. The deposit stays locked for 30 days after that identity’s last bid, and the market enforces the limit per funded identity. An attacker can create names freely, but gaining 1,000 bidding slots requires tying up $100,000; splitting existing funds among more names creates no extra slots.
